assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Prepare an isolated authenticated user, project, and prebuilt WASM build, then open /get-started.
steps.expected: The signed-in deployment workspace loads with the isolated project and deployable build available.
steps.observed: Signed in as e2e-pipeline-ut+browser-r4-20260315t141241@example.com on /get-started. Prepared project proj_7997 and built artifact bld_ab8115d046c393cc6a97fbe6 (buildStrategy prebuilt_wasm, resource profile CPU 250m / RAM 512MB / Disk 1024MB).

steps.action: In the deployment form, select the isolated project/build, set target ref browser-deploy-r4-1773583961551, set runtime env, and apply project filters for deployments/domains.
steps.expected: The form accepts the isolated project and built artifact, and the project filters narrow the lists to only the isolated records.
steps.observed: Deployment form accepted proj_7997 and bld_ab8115d046c393cc6a97fbe6. Before submit the filtered deployments list showed Total: 0 / No deployments yet, confirming the filter narrowed to only the isolated project.

steps.action: Submit a preview deployment from the deployment form and observe the immediate result card.
steps.expected: The result card shows deployment ID, status, domain, reachable endpoint link, and resource profile.
steps.observed: Result card rendered Deployment Created with deployment ID dep_49f5d0f141ba8ffa946d1f5d, status starting (updating...), launch mode stdout-bridge, domain e2e-pipeline-ut-browser-r4-20260315t141241-1.janus.run, and resource profile CPU 250m / RAM 512MB / Disk 1024MB (low). The reachable endpoint stayed at 'Polling for runtime endpoint...' instead of becoming a link.

steps.action: Wait for UI auto-refresh/polling without clicking Refresh Deployments or Refresh Domains.
steps.expected: The deployment result card, deployments list, and domains list auto-refresh to the running state with a reachable endpoint link for the isolated deployment.
steps.observed: The browser issued repeated GET /api/v1/deployments/dep_49f5d0f141ba8ffa946d1f5d polls, but after 15s the result card still showed starting (updating...) / Polling for runtime endpoint..., the filtered deployment card still showed starting with 'Reachable Endpoint: Not available yet', and the filtered domain card still showed starting with 'Reachable Endpoint: Check deployment runtime endpoint in Deployments panel'. Separate API checks showed the same deployment/domain were already running with runtimeEndpoint http://janus-runner:37775.

steps.action: Open View Logs from the isolated deployment card.
steps.observed: View Logs opened a deployment log modal for dep_49f5d0f141ba8ffa946d1f5d. The modal showed deployment logs including 'stdout-compatible wasm runtime ready at http://janus-runner:37775'.

network: GET /api/v1/auth/me loaded the authenticated user in the dashboard.
GET /api/v1/projects, /api/v1/builds, /api/v1/deployments, and /api/v1/domains loaded the initial dashboard state.
GET /api/v1/operations/op_7991adfade586b64676af1c5 returned status succeeded with deployment result status starting plus domainBinding/resourceProfile payloads.
The browser then issued repeated GET /api/v1/deployments/dep_49f5d0f141ba8ffa946d1f5d polls, but the UI never merged the running runtimeEndpoint into the result/deployment/domain cards.

Independent API evidence in api-state.json shows GET /api/v1/deployments/dep_49f5d0f141ba8ffa946d1f5d and the matching domain record were already running with runtimeEndpoint http://janus-runner:37775 while the UI remained stale.

assertions.issues: VAL-FH-018 fails on the current post-fix stack because the deployment submit path does not finish the UI state transition: the immediate result card never shows a reachable endpoint link, the deployment/domain cards remain stuck at starting, and the browser keeps polling even though the backend has already advanced the isolated deployment and domain to running with runtimeEndpoint http://janus-runner:37775. The project filters and View Logs modal worked.

frictions.description: On /get-started, agent-browser snapshot/annotate and networkidle waits repeatedly timed out even though the page was reachable. This made the normal ref-based workflow unreliable for this route.
frictions.resolution: Restarted only the assigned browser session per guidance, then used fixed waits, plain screenshots, CSS/semantic locators, and direct DOM extraction to complete the validation without restarting shared services.

summary: VAL-FH-018 failed: deployment creation from the isolated prebuilt WASM build succeeded and View Logs opened, but the deployment result/deployments/domains UI never auto-refreshed from starting to running or surfaced the runtime endpoint link even though the backend and browser polling data showed the isolated deployment/domain were already running.
